name: Ijen Geopark Run 2026
short_description: A half-marathon event on August 23, 2026, at Paltuding Camp in the Kawasan Ijen Geopark, Banyuwangi, Indonesia.
ai_summary: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 23, 2026, held at Paltuding Camp within the Kawasan Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur, Indonesia. Organised by Gamatera with Beyond Run as race management, as the opening race of the Geopark Run Series 2026-2027, the race offers three distance options: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance.

core_facts.organizer: Gamatera, with Beyond Run as race management (Geopark Run Series)
core_facts.venue: Paltuding Camp, Kawasan Ijen Geopark, Banyuwangi

pros: Scenic highland routes from Paltuding on Mount Ijen, mostly paved with some trail
Three distances, including a family-friendly 5K out-and-back
Water about every 2.5 km, and a 3am shuttle from Banyuwangi and Bondowoso
cons: Every route finishes uphill; the 21K climbs about 430 m in its last 8 km
Cold at the 1,870 m start, with 5°C to 12°C forecast by the organiser
Slow times: only 7 of 149 half-marathon finishers broke two hours
The 21K cut-off was stated as 4.5 hours on the race page and 4 hours in the FAQ
No refunds, no distance changes and no race-day pack collection
research_highlights: This is the inaugural edition of the Ijen Geopark Run brand and the opening leg of the new Geopark Run Series 2026-2027, held in the Ijen UNESCO Global Geopark area of Banyuwangi.
Race day is Sunday 23 August 2026, with race pack collection (RPC) scheduled for 21-22 August 2026 in Banyuwangi city.
Categories on offer are 5K, 10K and Half Marathon (21K).
Regular entry was Rp 300,000 (5K), Rp 350,000 (10K) and Rp 400,000 (21K), with a 50% Super Early Bird rate for the first 100 registrants, per the official FAQ.
The venue/start area is listed as Bumi Perkemahan Paltuding – Curah Macan, Tamansari, Licin, Banyuwangi — the same volcanic mountain area used for other Ijen sport-tourism events.
research_watchouts: The course is mixed terrain: the official race-day page describes mostly asphalt, with some trail sections on the 10K and 21K, and asks runners to watch their footing on those sections.
The organiser's race-day page, citing BMKG, expected about 5-12Â°C at 5am and 10-18Â°C at 7am at Paltuding, and advised bringing a windbreaker or jacket for before and after the race.

faqs.question: When is the Ijen Geopark Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 23, 2026. The event will be held at Paltuding Camp, located within the Kawasan Ijen Geopark in Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, offering runners a distinctive geopark setting for the race.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at the Ijen Geopark Run 2026: 5km, 10km, or 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon serves as the primary distance for the event, though shorter options are available for those seeking a less demanding race.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Ijen Geopark Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Ijen Geopark Run 2026 is organised by Gamatera, with Beyond Run as race management, according to the official FAQ. It was the opening race of the Geopark Run Series 2026-2027, which continues at other Indonesian geoparks, and started and finished at the Paltuding campground in Banyuwangi, East Java.
